info.title: PICK
info.description:
Community-built companion API for the Roblox game **Prospecting!**. It exposes wiki-sourced items, formulas, calculators, search, and public dataset snapshots.

Data is scraped from the official Prospecting! wiki on a schedule. Calculator endpoints are grouped under `/api/v1/calculators`.
